scope: Local pretrained Auto-AVSR English upload and webcam application; no deployment
dataset_strategy: Public LRS2 split distributions on Hugging Face by MahmoodAnaam; verify file contents and split IDs, record provenance, no gated access bypass
training_strategy: Freeze encoder and decoder body; adapt CTC and attention output layers with true LRS2 training labels; select on validation, evaluate official test separately, retain pretrained weights unless validation improves
caveat: Base checkpoint already trained on LRS2 train/validation-related data; adaptation validation is not evidence of unseen-speaker generalization. Official test split must not be used for tuning.
